scope: Static transport/evidence-preservation review only. No API, download, measurement or synthetic control was executed by this reviewer. Not a new formal dispatch or source gate.
accepted_properties: Finite observe pagination bounded to10pages, snapshot non-atomic explicitly recorded; no polling sleep, dispatch, rerun or automatic retry.
Pending/null G/run cannot execute; exact run ID/head/attempt1/event/branch/workflow and artifact run/head/name are checked.
Fresh attempt directory and xb/x writes preserve prior and failed partial bytes; download child real integer exit/timing retained.
Absolute/traversal/noncanonical/duplicate/symlink/special/encrypted members rejected. Regular members read through zipfile CRC and hashed, originalZIP digest checked and rechecked after extraction.
Transport receipt explicitly leaves raw validate_build/validate_shard/aggregate pending and grants no measurement/TODO credit; paginated observed items are not counted as accepted primary samples.

findings.finding: size_matches_api is recorded but never enforced. A ZIP with an official size mismatch may reach transport_received, including when official digest is absent.
findings.minimal_change: Write original zip receipt first, then reject size mismatch before extraction, retaining bytes/receipt and actual failure.

findings.finding: Metadata API stderr survives only via UTF-8 replacement decoding embedded in JSON. Exact raw stderr bytes cannot be reconstructed.
findings.minimal_change: Save raw stderr with xb beside raw stdout, and include both byte lengths/hashes and actual integer exit.

findings.finding: Member validation reads ZipInfo.filename; Python zipfile may truncate this at embedded NUL. Use orig_filename to reject NUL before canonical path checks so recorded name cannot silently differ from archived name.
findings.minimal_change: Reject NUL in member.orig_filename, reject unexpected orig_filename/filename mismatch, optionally reject Windows drive prefix for portable extraction.

non_blocking_notes: GitHub digest absent is honestly github_digest_verified=false, so do not promote transport_received to digest-verified evidence.
API pagination can duplicate/miss live items across pages; snapshot_is_not_atomic already records this. Final semantic collector must establish exact150 distinct required shards/1500records.
Extracted executable mode is not restored, but original external_attr and extracted_mode are recorded. Any later ELF replay setup must separately record mode handling.
Explicit --attempt permits a new preserved transport directory; it must remain root-authorized and never replace or retry original primary workload.

provided_synthetic_controls.scope: Author-provided existing synthetic records; no independent execution by this reviewer. Current9 omit size mismatch and embedded NUL controls.
